title: Important Update: E-Invoicing for RCM Domestic & Import Supplies Mandatory from Jan 1, 2027!
content:
# Important Update: E-Invoicing for RCM Domestic & Import Supplies Mandatory from Jan 1, 2027!

Hello everyone! Ek important update hai from the GSTN. Government ne **Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM) ke under domestic supplies (RCMDOM) aur import of services (RCMIMP) ke liye e-Invoicing** mandatory announce kiya hai.

GSTN ne **Advisory No. 688, dated November 17, 2026**, issue ki hai, jo ki is naye mandate ki details specify karti hai.

Yahaan kuch key points hain jo aapko pata hone chahiye:

*   **Applicability Date:** E-Invoicing for RCMDOM and RCMIMP will be mandatory from **January 1, 2027**.
*   **Background:** This is in continuation of an earlier advisory dated October 16, 2026, and is based on **Notification No. 04/2026-Central Tax** and **Notification No. 05/2026-Central Tax**, both dated **October 26, 2026**. These notifications extended the applicability of e-invoicing to these two categories of supplies and also brought corresponding amendments to the CGST Rules and e-Invoice schema.
*   **Production Rollout & Voluntary Adoption:** To ensure a smooth transition, the functionality will be enabled in the production environments of all six Invoice Registration Portals (IRPs) from **December 15, 2026**. Taxpayers can voluntarily generate Invoice Reference Numbers (IRNs) for RCMDOM and RCMIMP in the production environment between **December 15, 2026, and December 31, 2026**, for early adoption and integration readiness.
*   **Document Date Rule:** The system will accept documents dated **December 15, 2026, or later** for IRN generation in the production environment for these new supply types.
*   **Sandbox Availability:** The functionality for RCMDOM and RCMIMP is already available in the sandbox environments of all IRPs for testing and system integration.

All taxpayers, GST Suvidha Providers, Application Service Providers, and ERP providers are advised to complete the necessary system development, integration, and testing well before January 1, 2027.
